page.overview:
What is Team Poképals?

Team PokéPals (チーム ポケダンズ Team Pokédans) is a Rescue Team from the anime special, Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness and Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness. It is comprised of Piplup and Chimchar. Sunflora and Grovyle have acted as temporary members in the 1st and 2nd specials respectively.
